expect_edges.note: import 'base.dart' — the positive control, 1.00 before A6.5
cross-file `extends`. Before A6.5 the parser minted a BARE-name NodeId (`Animal`) while the class is keyed `<module>::Animal`, so the edge dangled: `[INHERITS_FROM] 'Dog' -> '?'`
SAME-file `extends` — dangled identically before A6.5; binds through the module's own symbols
cross-file `implements` — same bare-name phantom before A6.5
`with Runs` is emitted as IMPLEMENTS by design; binds to the mixin's CLASS node

note: A6.5: Dart heritage goes through UnresolvedRef (Bare) so resolve_refs binds it — same-file via module_symbols, cross-file via the repo-unique name. An external base (`extends StatelessWidget`) stays an unresolved ref and emits no edge. Marker: the engine's `[heritage] refs bound: ... dart=N ...` line.
